question.text: The 'Catch-up Rate' in a Cat III AIF distribution waterfall is:

answer.text: Rate at which residual profits are distributed to the Manager after investors get capital+hurdle, until Manager catches up to the pre-determined profit share (usually 20%)

explanation.text: The Logic: Catch-up allows the Manager to receive residual profits after investors' capital and hurdle have been paid, until the Manager reaches their agreed performance fee share. The Trap: Not a fee; not a tax; not trustee compensation. Cross-Exam Context: Core PE/VC waterfall concept (XIX-A). Distributor's Pro-Tip: When advising, check whether catch-up is 100% or partial — it dramatically changes cash flows.
